newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary supervisor extends Csiky broker suspension.
newsitem.headline: Hungary supervisor extends Csiky broker suspension.

text.p: Hungary's State Securities and Bourse Supervision (AETF) said on Tuesday that it had extended the freezing of brokerage Csiky Ertekpapir-Kereskedelmi Kft's accounts held by the Central Clearing House (KELER) to January 31 from December 31.
AETF froze the accounts on October 31 as it began an investigation into an option deal by Csiky for 150,000 shares in chemicals maker TVK concluded on the same day.

The investigation found that Csiky had not provided the required security for the transaction with KELER, but it was not yet clear if the brokerage owned either the securities or sufficient funds to back the option deal, the AETF said.
The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) also suspended Csiky indefinitely, saying information published by the brokerage had not given a clear picture of risks involved in its activities.
Following its decision on Csiky, the bourse suspended indefinitely all trade in traditional, or non-standardised, futures and options, saying that the markets were not sufficiently regulated.
